generalTab.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the general settings pane.

shortcutSectionCandidateSelection.comment: Shortcuts pane, first block's header: the keys that move through the candidate window.

shortcutSectionOutput.comment: Shortcuts pane, second block's header: the keys that end a composition into the document, and the switch for which script is written. 輸出 rather than 拍字 (USER 2026-09-10) — the block is about what reaches the document, not about the typing itself.

shortcutOpenSettings.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that opens the settings window on whichever pane it was last left on. Each row is authored whole rather than composed from the setting's own label.

shortcutToggleRomanization.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that switches between the two romanizations. Each row is authored whole rather than composed from the setting's own label, whose wording is a verb phrase in several languages.

values.ja: 台羅／白話字を切り替える

shortcutCycleCandidateDisplayMode.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that cycles Candidate Display through Hanji–Romanization Pairing → Hanji with Romanization → Romanization Only (the picker order). Authored whole, like its siblings.

values.ja: 候補の表示を切り替え

shortcutShowTelexGuide.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that toggles the floating Telex key-table guide (USER 2026-09-09). Authored whole, like its siblings.

shortcutShowSymbolPicker.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the chord that opens the symbol picker (punctuation / brackets / special symbols) styled as a candidate window (USER 2026-09-09). 拍開 since 2026-09-10 (USER), pairing it with shortcutOpenSettings — the pane draws the two doorways side by side. Authored whole, like its siblings.

shortcutMoveComposingCaret.comment: Read-only row under the composing keys on the Shortcuts pane: the fixed chord that moves the caret inside the romanization being typed (macOS ⌥←/⌥→, Windows Ctrl+←/→). Not recordable (USER 2026-09-09: "this feature can be shown on Shortcuts, but I don't plan to let users change it"). Authored whole, like its siblings.

shortcutFlipPunctuationWidth.comment: Read-only row after the commit rows on the Shortcuts pane: Ctrl on a punctuation key types it in the other width once (half-width in Hanji mode, full-width in romanization mode) without switching the mode (USER 2026-09-20). Taiwanese says 全角／半角, not 全形／半形 (USER 2026-09-20). Fixed like shortcutMoveComposingCaret; the value column lists sample chords (macOS ⌃, ⌃. ⌃;, Windows Ctrl+, Ctrl+. Ctrl+;). Authored whole, like its siblings.

values.ja: 句読点を全角／半角で入力

shortcutSelectCandidateSlot.comment: Read-only row under the candidate movers on the Shortcuts pane: the bare slot keys that pick a candidate straight off the visible page (QWDFZXVY; under Standard, 123456789 under Telex — follows the Tone Keys picker on the General pane, so nothing to record). The ⇧ twin of the same keys is the shortcutCommitAlternateScript read-only row (USER 2026-09-20). Authored whole, like its siblings.

shortcutNavigateCandidates.comment: Read-only row under the slot-key row on the Shortcuts pane: the fixed navigation keys that move the highlight through the candidate window (arrows, Page Up / Page Down); what ↓ does follows the window layout. Fixed tier, no binding can shadow it (USER 2026-09-20). Authored whole, like its siblings.

shortcutCancelComposing.comment: Read-only row after the commit rows on the Shortcuts pane: Escape drops the romanization being typed without writing anything to the document — the third way out beside Confirm Key and Output What You Are Typing. Fixed tier, not recordable (USER 2026-09-20: "Delete What You Are Typing"). Authored whole, like its siblings.

telexGuideTone.comment: Telex guide row meaning for a tone key; {tone} is the tone number (2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 9).

telexGuideInitial.comment: Telex guide row meaning for z: the unaspirated affricate initial it spells, written for the romanization in use — `ts` under TL, `ch` under POJ. {initial} is that spelling, so the row shows only the letters (USER 2026-09-11: no initial label).

telexGuideHyphen.comment: Telex guide row meaning for f: the syllable hyphen.

menuFile.comment: Menu-bar File menu title. An LSUIElement process builds its own menu bar so the settings window keeps the standard editing shortcuts.

dictionarySourcesLink.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the dictionary-source toggles page. iOS lists the toggles inline instead.

openURLFailed.comment: Alert title when NSWorkspace could not open a dictionary's web page. macOS-only: the iOS opener is fire-and-forget.

values.ja: ページを開けませんでした

customDictReadFailed.comment: Alert title when the custom-dictionary store could not be read.

values.en: Could Not Read the Custom Dictionary
values.ja: カスタム辞書を読み込めませんでした

customDictWriteFailed.comment: Alert title when a custom-dictionary write failed.

values.en: Could Not Save to the Custom Dictionary
values.ja: カスタム辞書に保存できませんでした

settingsWriteFailed.comment: Banner title in the settings window when settings.json could not be written (the control snaps back).

values.ja: 設定を保存できませんでした

progressWorking.comment: Label under the spinner while a Dictionary page runs any blocking job (save, delete, export, import). Desktop-only: the mobile apps have no blocking overlay.

importComplete.comment: Alert title after a CSV import finished. iOS titles the alert with the action's own name instead.

values.ja: 読み込みが完了しました

notUTF8Detail.comment: Alert body when an imported file is not UTF-8 — a different cause from a malformed CSV, which has its own message.

values.hanji: 這个檔案毋是 UTF-8 文字。
values.tailo: Tsit ê tóng-àn m̄-sī UTF-8 bûn-jī.
values.poj: Chit ê tóng-àn m̄-sī UTF-8 bûn-jī.
values.en: This file is not UTF-8 text.
values.ja: このファイルは UTF-8 テキストではありません。

entriesSection.comment: Section header over the custom-dictionary rows. The shared key is already the page title one line above.

candidateWindowLayout.comment: Picker label in the General pane: which shape the candidate window takes (horizontal row / vertical list / expandable grid).

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウの配置

candidateLayoutHorizontal.comment: Picker value: the horizontal single-row candidate window, paged left to right.

candidateLayoutVertical.comment: Picker value: the vertical scrolling-list candidate window.

candidateLayoutExpandable.comment: Picker value: the expandable candidate window — one row that unfolds into a grid via its chevron.

appearanceTab.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the candidate-window appearance pane (light/dark mode, layout, size, font).

candidateAppearanceLight.comment: Caption under the light-mode thumbnail in the Appearance pane's appearance selector, mirroring System Settings' Appearance row.

candidateAppearanceDark.comment: Caption under the dark-mode thumbnail in the Appearance pane's appearance selector, mirroring System Settings' Appearance row.

candidateWindowSize.comment: Picker label: the candidate window's one size knob — the text, the gaps and the air around them scale together (USER 2026-09-23).

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウの大きさ

sizeMedium.comment: Size-picker value: the default, middle step, named Standard (USER 2026-08-21).

shortcutsTab.comment: Sidebar label for the settings pane holding the shortcut rows.

actionNextCandidate.comment: Shortcut row: move the highlight to the next candidate.

actionPreviousCandidate.comment: Shortcut row: move the highlight to the previous candidate.

actionConfirmHighlighted.comment: Shortcut row: commit the highlighted candidate.

actionCommitLiteral.comment: Shortcut row: commit the romanization exactly as typed.

actionCommitAlternateScript.comment: Shortcut row: commit the highlighted candidate in the other script (Hanji / romanization). Also the label of the read-only row after it on the Shortcuts pane — Shift on a candidate slot key commits that slot in the other script (macOS ⇧QWDFZXVY; / ⇧123456789, Windows Shift+QWDFZXVY; / Shift+123456789, following the tone scheme; not recordable, USER 2026-09-10). One label for both: the key column already tells Space from the slot chords (USER 2026-09-10), so a second key held the same fact twice (merged 2026-09-20).

values.hanji: 輸出對換的文字（漢字/羅馬字）
values.ja: もう一方の文字で出力（漢字／ローマ字）

shortcutUnbound.comment: Shortcut recorder button when no key is assigned to the row.

shortcutRecording.comment: Shortcut recorder button while it is waiting for a key press.

values.ja: キーを押してください…

shortcutRejectedTaken.comment: Recorder error: the chord cannot be bound because something else already owns it — a romanization key, a key the input method reserves, a candidate-slot chord, a system shortcut, or the host app. One message covers every taken case; the recorder does not name the owner.

shortcutRejectedNoKey.comment: Recorder error: the event carried no key that could be recorded.

values.ja: 記録できるキーがありません

copyrightLine.comment: About page footer: authorship line beside the sponsor link. Same in every language — a personal name carries no translation. The year is a literal, updated by hand at release time.

aboutIntroProject.comment: About page, first line: what the project is. Two short paragraphs in all (USER 2026-09-20: "the description text is too much and too long"). Hanji authored by the USER 2026-09-20 (revised same day: paid-features + education-groups lines); tailo / poj generated 2026-09-20.

values.hanji: 台語齒盤是一个自由、開源 ê 台語拍字家私，永遠免費、無廣告，嘛袂推出付費功能。毋管是一般使用者、先生、學校抑是台語教育團體，攏會當自由使用。希望予逐家用台語、教台語 ê 時，免有額外 ê 負擔。
values.tailo: Tâi-gí Khí-puânn sī tsi̍t ê tsū-iû, khai-guân ê Tâi-gí phah-jī ke-si, íng-uán bián-huì, bô kóng-kò, mā bē tshui-tshut hù-huì kong-lîng. M̄-kuán sī it-puann sú-iōng-tsiá, sian-sinn, ha̍k-hāu ia̍h-sī Tâi-gí kàu-io̍k thuân-thé, lóng ē-tàng tsū-iû sú-iōng. Hi-bāng hōo ta̍k-ke iōng Tâi-gí, kà Tâi-gí ê sî, bián ū gia̍h-guā ê hū-tam.
values.poj: Tâi-gí Khí-pôaⁿ sī chi̍t ê chū-iû, khai-goân ê Tâi-gí phah-jī ke-si, éng-oán bián-hùi, bô kóng-kò, mā bē chhui-chhut hù-hùi kong-lêng. M̄-koán sī it-poaⁿ sú-iōng-chiá, sian-siⁿ, ha̍k-hāu ia̍h-sī Tâi-gí kàu-io̍k thoân-thé, lóng ē-tàng chū-iû sú-iōng. Hi-bāng hō͘ ta̍k-ke iōng Tâi-gí, kà Tâi-gí ê sî, bián ū gia̍h-gōa ê hū-tam.
values.en: TaigiKeyboard is a free, open-source Taiwanese input method — free forever, with no ads and no paid features ever. Everyday users, teachers, schools and Taiwanese-language education groups are all free to use it. The hope is that using and teaching Taiwanese comes with no extra burden.
values.ja: 台語齒盤は、自由でオープンソースの台湾語入力ツールです。ずっと無料で、広告もなく、有料機能を出すこともありません。一般の利用者、先生、学校、台湾語教育団体のどなたでも自由に使えます。台湾語を使うとき、教えるときに、余計な負担がないことを願っています。

aboutIntroMaintainer.comment: About page, second line: one maintainer, the hope. Hanji authored by the USER 2026-09-20 (revised same day: paid-features + education-groups lines); tailo / poj generated 2026-09-20.

values.hanji: 這个計畫目前由我一个人利用上班以外 ê 時間開發佮維護。向望會當一直做落去，予逐个想欲用母語拍字 ê 人，攏會當輕鬆用母語拍字。
values.tailo: Tsit ê kè-uē bo̍k-tsiân iû guá tsi̍t ê lâng lī-iōng siōng-pan í-guā ê sî-kan khai-huat kah uî-hōo. Ǹg-bāng ē-tàng it-ti̍t tsò lo̍h-khì, hōo ta̍k ê siūnn-beh iōng bó-gí phah-jī ê lâng, lóng ē-tàng khin-sang iōng bó-gí phah-jī.
values.poj: Chit ê kè-ōe bo̍k-chiân iû goá chi̍t ê lâng lī-iōng siōng-pan í-gōa ê sî-kan khai-hoat kah ûi-hō͘. Ǹg-bāng ē-tàng it-ti̍t chò lo̍h-khì, hō͘ ta̍k ê siūⁿ-beh iōng bó-gí phah-jī ê lâng, lóng ē-tàng khin-sang iōng bó-gí phah-jī.
values.en: This project is developed and maintained by one person, in the hours outside a day job. I hope to keep it going, so that everyone who wants to type in their mother tongue can do so with ease.
values.ja: このプロジェクトは現在、私一人が本業以外の時間で開発と保守を行っています。これからも続けていき、母語で入力したいすべての人が、気軽に母語で入力できることを願っています。

sponsorLink.comment: About page: the first link card, out to the ECPay donation page (USER 2026-09-20: a row like the links under it, not a button).

values.ja: 齒盤の維持・運営を支援する

websiteLink.comment: About page: title of the website link card. The host name itself — same in every language.

githubLink.comment: About page footer: tooltip + accessibility name of the GitHub icon link. A product name — same in every language.

discordLink.comment: About page footer: tooltip + accessibility name of the Discord icon link. A product name — same in every language.

emailLink.comment: About page footer: tooltip + accessibility name of the email icon link. The address itself — same in every language.

updateCheckNow.comment: Button in the Settings General pane that checks for an update immediately, next to the installed version, and the input-source menu row that does the same.

updateCurrentVersionLabel.comment: Settings General pane: the installed version, shown beside the check button. Wording mirrors home.json `version`.

updateAvailableTitle.comment: Update alert: title when the manifest names a newer version than the installed one.

values.ja: 新しいバージョンがあります

updateAvailableMessage.comment: The one sentence announcing a downloadable version, on both surfaces that announce it: the manual-check sheet and the system notification. The installed version is not repeated and the reader is not told to click — a notification is what it is (USER 2026-08-28: "concise, clear wording is enough").

values.hanji: 台語齒盤 {latest} 會使下載矣。
values.ja: 台語キーボード {latest} がダウンロードできます。

updateDownloadAction.comment: Update alert: default button — opens the download page in the browser.

updateLaterAction.comment: Update alert: dismisses without recording anything — the next check may notify again.

updateUpToDateTitle.comment: Manual-check alert: the installed version is already the newest published one.

updateCheckFailedTitle.comment: Manual-check alert: the check could not complete. Automatic checks fail silently instead.

values.ja: アップデートに問題が発生しました

updateCheckFailedMessage.comment: Manual-check alert: generic recovery line — no error taxonomy, the user's only remedy is the network and retrying.

values.hanji: 請檢查網路了後才閣試。
values.tailo: Tshiánn kiám-tsa bāng-lōo liáu-āu tsiah koh tshì.
values.poj: Chhiáⁿ kiám-cha bāng-lō͘ liáu-āu chiah koh chhì.
values.en: Check your network connection and try again.
values.ja: ネットワーク接続を確認してから、もう一度お試しください。

updateNotifyOfferTitle.comment: Title of the one-time offer, shown the first time the settings window opens: may we notify about new versions?

values.hanji: 有新版本的時陣通知你？
values.tailo: Ū sin pán-pún ê sî-tsūn thong-ti lí?
values.poj: Ū sin pán-pún ê sî-chūn thong-ti lí?
values.ja: 新しいバージョンをお知らせしますか？

updateNotifyOfferEnable.comment: Default button of the one-time notification offer; accepting it is what triggers the system permission prompt.

updatePendingVersionLabel.comment: Settings General pane row shown while a newer version is known but not installed. The surface that stays accurate with no network and after a missed notification.

values.ja: バージョン {version} があります

updateNotificationsOffNote.comment: Settings General pane row shown when notifications are refused. Says what turning them on gets you rather than what is currently lost (USER 2026-08-24: "make it more positive"), and leads out to where it is changed. The key name still describes when the row appears, not what it says.

values.hanji: 系統通知拍開，才會收著更新通知
values.tailo: Hē-thóng thong-ti phah-khui, tsiah ē siu-tio̍h king-sin thong-ti
values.poj: Hē-thóng thong-ti phah-khui, chiah ē siu-tio̍h keng-sin thong-ti
values.en: Turn on system notifications to receive update notices
values.ja: システム通知をオンにすると、アップデートのお知らせを受け取れます

updateOpenNotificationSettings.comment: Settings General pane link out to the System Settings notifications pane, beside the notifications-off note.

updateDownloadAndInstallAction.comment: Settings General pane: fetches the update package in the app, replacing the trip to the download page. Shown only when the manifest names a package and this build can pin its signer.

values.ja: ダウンロードしてインストール

updateInstallAction.comment: Settings General pane: opens the downloaded package in Installer.app. The user's second press — arrival never launches anything by itself.

updateRetryAction.comment: Settings General pane: tries a failed update download again.

updateInstallFailedNote.comment: Settings General pane: the update could not be installed — download, package verification, or launching the installer failed. Retryable; the retry button says what to do, and updateCheckFailedMessage already carries the network advice.

values.ja: インストールに失敗しました

clearLearningRecords.comment: Destructive row in the Dictionary pane: deletes the frequency AND association records in one go. Acts on click, with no confirmation (USER 2026-08-25). macOS has no per-record management UI, so this is the only way to discard what the keyboard learned.

clearLearningRecordsDone.comment: Alert title after the Delete Learning Records row finishes.

values.ja: 学習記録を消去しました

clearLearningRecordsFailed.comment: Alert title when Delete Learning Records could not empty a table. The store's own diagnostic follows as the body.

values.ja: 学習記録を消去できませんでした

installerDllLocked.comment: Windows installer (Inno Setup): the install stops because a running application still holds TaigiKeyboard.dll; the one recipe that frees it. No macOS counterpart (a .pkg replaces the bundle in place).

values.hanji: 台語齒盤猶咧使用中，檔案換袂掉。請先換做別个輸入法，登出 Windows 閣登入，才閣執行安裝程式。免重新開機。
values.tailo: Tâi-gí khí-puânn iáu teh sú-iōng-tiong, tóng-àn uānn bē tiāu. Tshiánn sing uānn-tsò pa̍t ê su-ji̍p-huat, ting-tshut Windows koh ting-ji̍p, tsiah koh tsip-hîng an-tsong thîng-sik. Bián tîng-sin khui-ki.
values.poj: Tâi-gí khí-pôaⁿ iáu teh sú-iōng-tiong, tóng-àn ōaⁿ bē tiāu. Chhiáⁿ seng ōaⁿ-chò pa̍t ê su-ji̍p-hoat, teng-chhut Windows koh teng-ji̍p, chiah koh chip-hêng an-chong thêng-sek. Bián têng-sin khui-ki.
values.en: TaigiKeyboard is still in use, so its files cannot be replaced. Switch to another input method, sign out of Windows and back in, then run this installer again. No restart is needed.
values.ja: TaigiKeyboard は使用中のため、ファイルを置き換えられません。別の入力方式に切り替え、Windows からサインアウトして再度サインインしてから、このインストーラーをもう一度実行してください。再起動は不要です。

installerStepFailed.comment: Windows installer: a registration or scheduled-task step failed after the files were copied; the previous version was restored. {step} names the failed command.

values.hanji:
安裝步驟失敗：{step}
若有舊版，已經復原。詳細請看安裝紀錄。
values.tailo:
An-tsong pōo-tsàu sit-pāi: {step}
Nā ū kū-pán, í-king ho̍k-guân. Siông-sè tshiánn khuànn an-tsong kì-lo̍k.
values.poj:
An-chong pō͘-chàu sit-pāi: {step}
Nā ū kū-pán, í-keng ho̍k-goân. Siông-sè chhiáⁿ khòaⁿ an-chong kì-lo̍k.
values.en:
Setup failed at: {step}
The previous version, if any, was put back. Details are in the setup log.
values.ja:
セットアップに失敗した手順: {step}
以前のバージョンがあれば元に戻しました。詳細はセットアップのログを参照してください。

installerSignOutNote.comment: Windows installer: the line added to the finished page — a new text service can need a sign-out before Windows lists it.

values.hanji: 若是輸入法清單內底無看著台語齒盤，請登出 Windows 閣再登入。
values.tailo: Nā-sī su-ji̍p-huat tshing-tuann lāi-té bô khuànn-tio̍h Tâi-gí khí-puânn, tshiánn ting-tshut Windows koh-tsài ting-ji̍p.
values.poj: Nā-sī su-ji̍p-hoat chheng-toaⁿ lāi-té bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tâi-gí khí-pôaⁿ, chhiáⁿ teng-chhut Windows koh-chài teng-ji̍p.
values.en: If TaigiKeyboard does not appear in the input-method list, sign out of Windows and sign in again.
values.ja: 入力方式の一覧に TaigiKeyboard が表示されない場合は、Windows からサインアウトして再度サインインしてください。

installerUpdateTaskSkippedNote.comment: Windows installer: the line added to the finished page when the daily update-check task could not be created. The install itself succeeded; only the background check is missing.

values.hanji: 自動檢查更新設定袂起來，請佇設定內底手動檢查。
values.tailo: Tsū-tōng kiám-tsa king-sin siat bē khí-lâi, tshiánn tī siat-tīng lāi-té tshiú-tōng kiám-tsa.
values.poj: Chū-tōng kiám-cha keng-sin siat bē khí-lâi, chhiáⁿ tī siat-tēng lāi-té chhiú-tōng kiám-cha.
values.en: Automatic update checks could not be set up. Check for updates in Settings instead.
values.ja: 更新の自動確認を設定できませんでした。設定から手動で更新を確認してください。

customFontAdd.comment: Appearance pane button that opens a file panel to take a font file into the user's typeface library.

customFontMissing.comment: Appearance pane note shown when the selected custom typeface's file is gone or will not activate; the candidate window falls back to the system font and the preference is kept.

values.hanji: 揣無字型，先用系統字型
values.tailo: Tshuē-bô jī-hîng, sian iōng hē-thóng jī-hîng
values.poj: Chhōe-bô jī-hêng, sian iōng hē-thóng jī-hêng
values.en: The selected typeface is missing — using the system font
values.ja: 選択したフォントが見つかりません。システムフォントを使用します

customFontAlreadyInstalled.comment: Manage Typefaces receipt shown when the user imports a font file whose face this computer already has; the import is dropped and the installed row is selected instead.

values.hanji: 這个字型電腦本底就有
values.tailo: Tsit ê jī-hîng tiān-náu pún-té tō ū
values.poj: Chit ê jī-hêng tiān-náu pún-té tō ū
values.en: This computer already has this typeface
values.ja: このフォントはすでにインストールされています

customFontRemoveFailed.comment: Appearance pane failure title when a custom typeface could not be removed, which is what macOS reports while something still holds the font.

values.ja: 削除できませんでした

fontManagementTab.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the pane where the candidate window's typeface is chosen and the user's own typefaces are added and removed.

aboutTab.comment: Input-source menu row and settings window title: the About page, reachable only from the menu — no sidebar row.

menuSettings.comment: Input-method menu row that opens the settings window, on all three desktops (USER 2026-09-24: menus identical incl. i18n). Names the keyboard because Fcitx5 lists its own input-method settings row in the same menu (Mozc: 「Mozc 設定」); wording from a Discord report 2026-09-24.

values.ja: 台湾語キーボードの設定
